title: Design system preview keeps put-back addresses plain through Cloudflare (no-transform), says why a preview is not available as the stage notice, and the try's bar outlives the Design system tab
steps: S3: On cowork.tracy.site, open a Design system card's preview on a Joomla demo behind Cloudflare; then on a site whose template has no slot; then press Try on your site on a supported site.
expect: S1: every test passes: the measured Business Joomla markup decodes to mailto in any attribute order and the decode script goes whatever its host; the demo door's answer carries Cache-Control no-transform and no data-cfemail, email-protection or email-decode.

S2: every test passes: a 409 NO_SLOT preview renders the stage notice with one info icon and the template line, no bare data-preview-unavailable paragraph; after Try the Design system tab can unmount and the bar stays on the page with Undo and Keep, Undo presses the undo door and reloads the Browser tab; the way back announces tracy:design-system-changed.

S3: the demo's addresses read as addresses in the frame; the no-slot site shows the centred notice with the info icon saying the template cannot wear a design system yet; after Try the Browser panel is in front and the bar with Undo and Keep is still at the bottom of the window.
evidence: Measured 13/10/2026 on cowork.tracy.site after PR #1301 deployed: GET /api/design-system/preview for tracy-business/j6 answered 200 with 2 data-cfemail, 1 email-decode, 0 mailto while the same HTML decoded clean at the machine; tracy.ai preview showed one bare line with no icon or reason; [data-try-bar] count 0 right after Try with the apply through
fence: The apply and undo doors are unchanged; the preview's CSP and its page-by-page links are unchanged; no new i18n keys
